reader_summary.overview: Today, we're featuring another episode of The Rewind, in which Howard looks back on some of his memos over the years, discusses their origins. thesis: Howard Marks argues that investors should not take instructions from the market because it is not always wrong, but merely sometimes or often wrong. To outperform, investors must deviate from the consensus and recognize that market movements can be driven by technical forces and unappreciated factors rather than just fundamentals.
